about_the_game:
Welcome to the Circle Empires 2 demo! 

Circle back to the latest chapter in the fast-paced real-time strategy series where you expand your empire, circle by circle, in this first slice of CIRCLE EMPIRES 2!

Conquer a world of interconnected circles filled with resources, enemies, and strategic challenges. Build your armies and adapt to ever-changing worlds that make each playthrough unique in this demo.

The CIRCLE EMPIRES 2 universe is made up of... circles! Each one is its own little ecosystem, teeming with resources, wildlife, and enemies. Conquer them all to expand your empire, but beware: each circle holds new dangers, from vicious villains to brutal bosses. 

Your mission? Fight, Conquer, Expand! Unite all circles under your rule.

UNITS GALORE Explore our new unit customisation options, by building and commanding an army of diverse units, each with unique skills and abilities. With 8 races, 36 weapons, and two sets of armour, you'll have lots to play around with! Plus, they now have facial expressions, so you can read the battlefield like never before.

A NEVERENDING KERFUFFLE Every playthrough brings a new world to explore, filled with different circles, biomes, and challenges. No two games are the same! Whether you prefer to strategize at a leisurely pace or dive headfirst into chaos, the CIRCLE EMPIRES 2 demo offers a range of difficulty settings to suit your style. Plus, the new randomly generated maps ensure endless replayability as you face different obstacles and enemies each time.

MULTIPLAYER What’s better than building your empire alone? Doing it with (or against) your pals!

In the demo’s multiplayer mode, you can team up with allies to conquer the world together or compete against each other to see who can build the strongest empire. With unique factions, cooperative gameplay, and competitive modes, multiplayer takes the action to the next level and creates an endless challenge.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Fast-Paced Real-Time Strategy Gameplay: Build, expand, and battle your way through this demo!

  • Two Gamemodes: Conquer all circles in Full Conquest or take on one of our Daily Challenges.

  • Multiplayer modes: Play the demo cooperatively or competitively with friends.

  • Four bosses: Vanquish Wolfram the Warlord, Barg the Barbarian, Nethier the Necromancer, and Wiz the Wizard.

  • Diverse units and upgrades: Get familiar with our unit customization features - with 36 different weapons, 2 pieces of armour and 10 cosmetic elements available in the demo.

  • Mounting system: Combine units creatively — mount smaller units on 3 of the larger creatures from Circle Empires 2 for unique advantages.

  • Improved AI and tactics: Enemies use smarter strategies, forcing you to adapt and rethink your approach.

  • Dynamic biomes: Explore a range of environments to conquer and use them to your advantage, from scorching deserts to eerie swamps and use each captured circle to your advantage as it affects your gameplay.

  • Rich customization: Tweak your demo experience with 5 modifiers and 6 map sizes!

  • Exciting new features: Experience new units, buildings, terrain effects, and upgrades that add depth and strategy.

Circle Empires brings a fresh twist to the original formula, offering new ways to conquer, build, and explore. Ready to circle back in? The circles await!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i3 4130 or AMD FX 6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD RX460
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Circle Empires 2 can be played on significantly older devices but larger maps and numbers of units will effect performance. The minimum requirements aim to facilitate all scenarios of normal gameplay.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5 6700K or AMD R5 1500X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650 or AMD RX480
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Expand your empire, circle by circle, in this demo for the fast-paced follow-up to the hit RTS, Circle Empires. Gather resources, build armies, and defeat bosses (or your friends) in a world that changes with every game. With unique units and biomes, it's an addictive battle of wits and tactics.
